-- forever-route-lab RXP parser fixture 03: Lua-wrapped guides (the form used in an addon's .lua file).
-- Self-authored (GPL-3.0-or-later). Saved as .txt so no tool treats it as runnable Lua.
-- The importer must extract guide text statically. It must NEVER execute this Lua.
-- Expected: 4 guides extracted (A-D), 1 dynamic call reported and skipped (E), the block
-- comment ignored, and the faction guard below reported as ignored (RXP021-lua-guard-ignored).
-- Guide C also checks that whitespace before "(" and after "," is accepted.
-- Coordinates are placeholders. "RXPGuides.RegisterGuide([[" is the addon's registration API
-- (interoperability vocabulary, D-019). It is the only line of 24 or more characters here that
-- also occurs in RXP guides (docs/RXP.md section 19.2).

local playerFaction = UnitFactionGroup("player")
if playerFaction ~= "Horde" then return end

-- Guide A: single-argument form with a level-0 long bracket.
-- The first newline right after "[[" is not part of the string (Lua rule).
RXPGuides.RegisterGuide([[
#forever
<< Horde
#name 6-8 Fixture Three
#version 3
#group Forever Route Lab Fixtures
#subgroup Parser Samples

step
    .goto Durotar,52.00,43.00
    >>Wrapped guide A, first step
    .zone Durotar >>Enter Durotar
]])

-- Guide B: level-2 long bracket, because the text itself contains "]]".
RXPGuides.RegisterGuide([==[
#forever
#name 6-8 Fixture Three (Alt)
#version 1
#group Forever Route Lab Fixtures

step
    *A star note that mentions a closing bracket pair ]] which would end a level-0 string\nand has an escaped line break
    .goto 1411,52.50,43.50,20
]==])

-- Guide C: two-argument form. The group comes from the first argument and any #group line
-- inside the text is ignored by RXP. The third argument is the defaultFor filter.
RXPGuides.RegisterGuide ("Forever Route Lab Fixtures", [[
#forever
#name 8-9 Fixture Four
#group This Line Is Ignored In The Two Argument Form
#version 1
step
    .goto Durotar,53.00,44.00,15
    >>Two-argument form
]], "Orc/Troll")

-- Guide D: a quoted string. Lua escapes (\n, \", \\) must be decoded before RXP parsing.
RXPGuides.RegisterGuide("#forever\n#name 9-10 Fixture Quoted\n#group Forever Route Lab Fixtures\n#version 1\nstep\n    >>Quoted form with a \"quote\" and a backslash \\ in it\n    .goto Durotar,53.50,44.50,15\n")

--[==[ A Lua block comment that contains a guide-shaped call. It must NOT be extracted.
(A level-0 "--[[" comment could not hold the "[[" below: Lua 5.1 rejects nested [[ ]].)
RXPGuides.RegisterGuide([[
#name Not A Guide
]])
]==]

-- Guide E: dynamic content (a variable joined with ".."). It must be reported as
-- RXP020-lua-dynamic and skipped. It must never be evaluated.
local prefix = "#forever\n"
RXPGuides.RegisterGuide(prefix .. [[
#name 10-10 Dynamic
#group Forever Route Lab Fixtures
step
    >>Never extracted
]])
